title: Reconcile path-sensitive release fingerprints for the first reversible seam
purpose: Record the failed first Stage C attempt as HOLD, obtain deterministic fingerprint evidence for the accepted source-only seam, and authorize only the release-metadata updates required by the existing path-sensitive source-tree guard without weakening that guard or changing product identity or behavior.
invariants: Pull request 44 and Remote Agent run 29329093616 remain recorded as a failed, unmerged Stage C attempt with no tested-result commit.
The failure must not be bypassed by deleting, weakening or excluding contract_source_tree.py or by altering the test runner.
The accepted developer source scope remains the four files defined by ARC-WP-010.
A disposable diagnostic agent result may apply the accepted seam and write only runtime_fingerprint_diagnostic.py plus fingerprint-diagnostic.json; it must never be merged into main.

The final integrator-owned release_config.json diff is limited to adding runtime part 04 to baseline_equivalence.ignored_script_paths and replacing runtime_fingerprint with the value computed from the exact final seam bytes.

The existing runtime_js_normalized_sha256 must remain unchanged unless the diagnostic proves that the accepted relocation changes normalized semantics after both old and new owners are ignored; such a change would require another governor decision.

The release configuration schema, RC, version label, build, base, principle, build timestamp, bundle label, human-validation block, every existing ignored path, CSS fingerprint and all other fields remain byte-for-byte semantically unchanged.
Adding part 04 to ignored_script_paths does not authorize future behavior in that path; it recognizes that its unchanged bytes were mechanically relocated from already ignored part 00.
No storage key, data shape, identifier, technology, UI, behavior or release identity changes are authorized.
Developer, adversarial QA, integrator and governor write paths remain disjoint.
Stage C remains HOLD until a fresh exact result passes all required checks and separate acceptance; Stage D remains blocked.
